# EscaPy ARM64 Offline Wheelhouse

This directory is included only in the v0.80.1 internal R&D package. It contains
the Python 3.12 ARM64 wheels pinned by
`scripts/escapy_arm64_requirements.lock`, including `pyscape==1.1.0`.

The installer uses `pip --require-hashes --no-index` and does not access the
network. EscaPy/pyscape is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later or a commercial
license. This R&D package is for the authorized K2B internal test environment.
